supersedes.reason: V5 resolved identity correctly but treated when-issued lines as ordinary rename intervals, so their bar availability could block the gate

lineage_state_types.REGULAR_WAY: canonical research interval — ingested, featured, episodic
lineage_state_types.WHEN_ISSUED: same corporate lineage, distinct temporary trading state; recorded in lineage, EXCLUDED from canonical regular-way history
lineage_state_types.NOT_YET_REGULAR_WAY: dates before the first canonical REGULAR_WAY interval
lineage_state_types.UNOBSERVED: a regular-way interval should exist but source coverage is unavailable
lineage_state_types.distinctness: WHEN_ISSUED is not UNOBSERVED, not NOT_YET_LISTED and not REGULAR_WAY; recording it as any of them would lose the reason the data is absent

when_issued_policy.detection: structural — an interval's ticker is when-issued if stripping a trailing w/W/V yields a LATER interval's ticker for the same security; no ticker is hard-coded
when_issued_policy.applied_before_availability: the four when-issued lines are excluded for what they ARE, not for what came back. GEHCV and GEVw returned bars and SOLVw and VLTOw did not; all four are excluded identically.
when_issued_policy.why: a when-issued market has its own liquidity, participants and price discovery. Concatenating a day of it onto a regular-way series would change the measured object at the most fragile point — slot-RVOL and CUM-RVOL baselines, EMA initialisation, first-transition clocks and start-of-history semantics

raw_preservation.permitted: when-issued raw bars may be stored under raw/massive/when_issued/
never: concatenated into a canonical regular-way series
used to create a T/Z episode
raw_preservation.if_not_downloaded: the lineage metadata below is sufficient to show the interval was deliberately excluded rather than lost

ingest_rule.select: for each (security, session) use the REGULAR_WAY interval containing that session
ingest_rule.before_first: sessions before the first REGULAR_WAY interval are NOT_YET_REGULAR_WAY and are not requested
ingest_rule.when_issued: never requested as part of canonical history
ingest_rule.failure: a session inside a REGULAR_WAY interval that returns nothing is UNOBSERVED with its status code, never silently absent
